vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.kist_open: In the chest: Core Splinters, something rare, 5 silver and Craft Tokens!
vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.leeg: No orders for you yet. Get a bit better at a profession first!
vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.maak: %s wants you to make something %s times with %s.
vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.verzamel: %s wants you to gather %s things with %s.
vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.week: This week: %s/%s orders (then a Crafting Chest)
vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.week_klaar: This week: %s/%s, you got your weekly chest!
vadsrijk.ambacht.bestel.weekkist: Twelve orders this week: a Crafting Chest for you!
vadsrijk.ambacht.boek.geen_buff: No food buff. Eat something from the kitchen for 30 minutes of extra strength!
vadsrijk.ambacht.boek.hint.honing: Place a hive in the right bee meadow.
vadsrijk.ambacht.boek.hint.plek: A spot for %s. Ask the master guh in Shroomsbury, or the Guild in Highchonk, where it is.
vadsrijk.ambacht.boek.meer: Everything is also in the Exploration Book (B), on the Professions page.
vadsrijk.ambacht.boek.uitgerust: Rested: %s / %s min of double profession xp (builds up while you're offline)
vadsrijk.ambacht.eigenschap.eerste_klap: First hit on a creature +%s%% damage
vadsrijk.ambacht.eten.duur: 30 minutes · one food buff at a time · stays when you faint
vadsrijk.ambacht.eten.feest: For your whole party within 10 blocks + Snug (30 min)
vadsrijk.ambacht.eten.feest_mee: %s shares a feast with you! So snug!
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.brouwen.0.0: Blub! The sea doesn't turn the crystals here gray, it turns them salty. Salty crystal stays pink longer, did you know?
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.brouwen.0.2: Samphire and a little sponge from the deep. The un-gray potion keeps getting better.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.brouwen.1.0: With sky honey a crystal stays pink even in the fog. The Sky Elixir! My masterpiece... no, OUR masterpiece.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.brouwen.1.2: Blub blub! Master brewer. Let the Chonk Pipes shine.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.eerst: First finish your mentor's story: %s. They live in the hubs down below. Come back after that!
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.houthakken.0.0: Kite bamboo grows on Kite Island. Bendy, light, and it whistles in the wind.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.houthakken.0.2: Chop some bamboo first, and ask the sewers. Together you'll make the prettiest kites.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.houthakken.1.0: Cloudwood weighs almost nothing. You could build a house from it that stays floating.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.houthakken.1.2: Someday, maybe. First, you're a Master Woodcutter. The woods of Tail Park whisper your name.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.imkeren.0.0: Bzzzz, welcome to the Guild's bee stable. Our bees fly all the way to The Lantern Coast and back.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.imkeren.0.2: They want lantern honey! Put a hive on Flower Island, then they won't have to fly so far.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.imkeren.1.0: The bees of Highchonk dance in the clouds. They make sky honey, the sweetest in the whole Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.imkeren.1.1: Can I learn a little dance?
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.imkeren.1.2: You already know it: they dance for you. Master Beekeeper. Bzzzz!
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.koken.0.0: Look what the divers found: a page from Granny Trudy, in a bottle, in Coral Bay!
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.koken.0.2: 'Fishies from the pink sea, with a pinch of samphire.' Go ahead and make it, then we'll taste it together.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.koken.1.0: The very last page was in the Cathedral: 'The cookie the Emperor never got... starts with cloudberries.'
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.koken.1.2: Cloudberries. The rest we get to make up ourselves. Master Cook, that's you now. Granny would be proud.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.mijnen.0.0: Bonk is the mine master of Shroomsbury, I'm the one for Highchonk. He wrote that you tap well.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.mijnen.0.2: Haha, yes, exactly like that. There's lantern bronze on Pierhead. Tap softly, it still glows afterwards.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.mijnen.1.0: Do you know where sky silver comes from? From the fins of Mother Cloudwhale. She doesn't mind, it tickles her.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.mijnen.1.2: She winks back, see? Master Miner, that's you now.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.naaien.0.0: There you are! The quilt hangs in the Guild Hall now. There's room for one more patch: one from The Lantern Coast.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.naaien.0.2: Of sea yarn, with a little kite embroidered on it. Then the quilt will flutter a bit.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.naaien.1.0: And now the last patch: cloud wool. So soft that the Emperor himself might want to sleep under it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.naaien.1.2: Everybody wants a cuddle, sweetie. Even emperors. You are a Master Sewer now.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.plukken.0.0: Samphire! Have a taste, it crunches and it tastes like the sea.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.plukken.0.2: Salty and sweet, just like the sea guhs. Pick it gently and it grows back.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.plukken.1.0: The cloudberries in the Eye Garden are ripe. You have to pick them before they float away.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.plukken.1.2: Hee hee, it's true. Being quick and being gentle: that's a Master Picker. And that's you.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.smeden.0.0: Welcome to the Guild's smithy! The Anvil of the Order is whole, but Highchonk has another one: the Cloud Anvil.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.smeden.0.2: It hangs on chains above the city. Forge something pretty from lantern bronze first, then you may use it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.smeden.1.0: Hear that? The Cloud Anvil sings when you strike it. It only does that for masters.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.smeden.1.2: A Master Smith! Here in Highchonk we hang your hammer on the wall. Right next to the one from the old Order.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.uit: You know the Guild's whole story. When the Chonkdom grows, our story grows along with it!
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.vissen.0.0: Ahoy! I heard you went diving in Coral Bay. Bobby from Shroomsbury already knew it: you'll go far.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.vissen.0.2: And it grows back if you loosen it gently. That's how we take care of the sea.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.vissen.1.0: There are fish swimming in the fountain on Market Lane. Little cloudfish. Nobody knows how they got there.
vadsrijk.ambacht.gilde.vissen.1.2: Maybe it did! Master Fisher, you get to keep that mystery.
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z1_pluk_kamp: the meadow by the campfire of Camp Snuggle
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z1_vis_druipmeer: the lake in the Drip Shaft
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z3_korf_bloesemda: the bee meadow in Toadblossom Dale
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z3_korf_kever: the bee meadow in the Glowbeetle Woods
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z3_vis_honingvijv: the honey ponds in the canopy
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z4_duik_koraalbaa: diving by the diving pier (Coral Bay)
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z4_korf_bloemenei: the Bee Farm on Flower Island
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z4_korf_duinen: the dune flowers by the Beach Party
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z4_pluk_strandfee: the dunes by the Beach Party
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z5_hout_ooggaarde: the trees of the Eye Garden
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z5_korf_ooggaarde: the bee meadow in the Eye Garden
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z5_korf_staartpar: the bee meadow in Tail Park
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z5_mijn_noordvin: the north fin of Mother Cloudwhale
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z5_mijn_staartvin: the tail fin of Mother Cloudwhale
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.z5_mijn_zuidvin: the south fin of Mother Cloudwhale
vadsrijk.ambacht.hud.korf_vrij: Free hive spot (%2$s): click to place your hive
vadsrijk.ambacht.hud.uitgerust: Rested: %s min of double profession xp
vadsrijk.ambacht.korf.boos: Too fast! The bees are a bit grumpy (you're a little sticky).
vadsrijk.ambacht.korf.leeg: The combs aren't full yet. Come back later.
vadsrijk.ambacht.korf.neergezet: Your hive is up! Your bees are off to fetch nectar for %s.
vadsrijk.ambacht.korf.vol: You already have enough hives (max %s at this level).
vadsrijk.ambacht.meester.nu: You are now a Master of %s (level %s)! The Master's Apron is in your Wardrobe.
vadsrijk.ambacht.mini.duiken: Diving! Hold and let go in the green
vadsrijk.ambacht.mini.imkeren: Smoke! Hold and let go in the green
vadsrijk.ambacht.mini.mijnen: Fluff vein! Tap the sparkly bit!
vadsrijk.ambacht.mini.plukken: Gently! Hold and let go in the green
vadsrijk.ambacht.mw.geen_set: Custom gear never counts for a set bonus.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.bord.hallo: Hello! This is where the town's orders and the players' requests hang. And in the Craft Shop you trade in your tokens.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.brouw.hallo: Blub blub! In the brewery I make potions, and I cut crystals: three rough ones become one cut one.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.hout.hallo: Hello, little woodcutter! By the trees there are stumps you can chop. Chop to the rhythm and you get chonky wood.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.hout.uitleg: Right-click a stump and tap the pink twice. Every stump comes back after a minute, but somewhere else!
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.imker.hallo: Bzzzz! Welcome to the bee stable. Put your own hive by the flowers and your bees will fetch nectar.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.imker.uitleg: Click an empty hive spot to place your hive. Come back later: the more flowers, the faster the combs fill up. Harvesting = giving smoke (hold, let go in the green).
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.kok.hallo: Smell that? In the kitchen we make food with buffs: half an hour stronger, and it stays when you faint!
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.mijn.hallo: Hey, little miner! There are ore spots all over the Chonkdom. Only you can see yours.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.mijn.uitleg: Right-click an ore spot and tap the sparkly bit three times. Tap it well and you get chonky ore! Sneak-click skips the minigame.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.naai.hallo: Come on into the sewing studio! Pants, little shoes, and hats and decor for your home. All stitched with love.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.pluk.hallo: Hi, little picker! Herbs and fibers grow in the meadows. Pick them gently and they stay whole.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.pluk.uitleg: Right-click a plant, HOLD the mouse button and let go in the green bit. Too long? Then it's squished.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.smid.hallo: Welcome to the smithy! Here I forge made-to-measure weapons, helmets and breastplates. You pick the bonuses, I add a little extra sock.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.vis.hallo: Ahoy, fishy friend! Where the water bubbles, there are fish. At night and in the rain, other kinds bite.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.vis.uitleg: Right-click a bubbling spot, wait until you see 'Bite!' and then click right away. Too early? Then the fish gets spooked.
vadsrijk.ambacht.npc.waar: Have a look at %s, around x %s, z %s.
vadsrijk.ambacht.oogst.afk: You've been standing in the same spot for a while: the harvest is halved. Walk around a bit!
vadsrijk.ambacht.oogst.leeg: This spot is empty for now. It'll come back somewhere else soon.
vadsrijk.ambacht.oogst.niet_hier: That only works in the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.ambacht.opdracht.beloning: The reward is too low (at least 25 bronze each).
vadsrijk.ambacht.opdracht.beloning_label: Reward (goes into the pot right away):
vadsrijk.ambacht.opdracht.door: made by %s: go pick it up!
vadsrijk.ambacht.opdracht.eigen: You can't deliver your own request.
vadsrijk.ambacht.opdracht.geen_geld: You don't have enough coins for that reward.
vadsrijk.ambacht.opdracht.geplaatst: Your request is up on the board! The reward is in the pot.
vadsrijk.ambacht.opdracht.ingetrokken: Withdrawn: you get your coins back.
vadsrijk.ambacht.opdracht.kent_niet: You don't know this recipe yet.
vadsrijk.ambacht.opdracht.kent_niet_tip: You don't know this recipe yet (you have %s of the %s).
vadsrijk.ambacht.opdracht.klaar_melding: %s made your request: %s. Pick it up at a board guh or in the Professions book!
vadsrijk.ambacht.opdracht.leeg: No requests yet. Post one yourself!
vadsrijk.ambacht.opdracht.niet_genoeg: You don't have enough of what's being asked for on you.
vadsrijk.ambacht.opdracht.te_veel: You already have enough open requests.
vadsrijk.ambacht.rang.geen: You're not on this list yet.
vadsrijk.ambacht.tip.korf: Your bees fly to the flowers around your hive. The more flowers, the faster the combs fill up.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.0.0: Blub! Do you know why the crystals are turning gray? Me neither. But I'm going to find out!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.0.2: Brew a Chonk Potion first. Whoever can brew pink can beat gray.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.1.0: I put a gray crystal in the cauldron. It got... a little less gray!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.1.2: Blob clover and one really big cuddly thought. Science!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.2.0: Cut crystals keep the gray out better. That's why we cut them!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.3.0: With honey from The Duskroot the pink stays even at night! The un-gray potion is getting closer.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.3.2: The Honey Elixir. Sounds fancy, tastes like summer.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.4.0: It works! One drop of Honey Elixir and a gray crystal starts to shine. The Chonk Pipes will be so happy.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brouwen.4.2: We sure did, Journeyman Brewer. Here, a Mini King Blob for your shelf.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.0.0: You don't just go chopping wood. First you thank the tree.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.0.2: Well done. Here, some shroom stem to practice with. Chop to the rhythm: nyeg-nyeg.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.1.0: Every stump you chop grows back somewhere else. The forest dances a little.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.1.2: They move house! That's why you have to look around carefully.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.2.0: Crystal pine from the Splinter Peaks. It rings like a little bell when you tap it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.2.2: Tink! Yes. Lovely wood for a bow.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.3.0: Duskwood cries pink resin. Not sad tears, mind you, just happy sap.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.3.2: Happy sap. Smiths use it for their best work.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.4.0: You chop like a real forest guh. The forest whispers your name.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.houthakken.4.2: 'Thank you.' Journeyman Woodcutter! Here, an Overshroom Statuette for your home.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.0.0: Bees are guhs with little wings. They share everything, just like us.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.0.1: Can I have a hive too?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.0.2: Of course! Put it near lots of flowers. The more flowers, the faster the honey.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.1.0: Every meadow gives a different honey: blossom honey, dusk honey, root honey.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.1.1: I want to taste them all!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.1.2: Then you'll have to put a hive everywhere. On to the next meadow!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.2.0: Watch out for the Mika Beekeeper. He sucks the combs empty with a cheese pump.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.2.2: Mean, yes. But our bees are smarter. They hide the best honey.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.3.0: Your bees already know your voice. Can you hear them buzzing when you come near?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.3.2: Just like that. Sometimes you'll find royal jelly: the yummiest thing in the hive.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.4.0: You're a real beekeeper. The bees have made you an honorary member.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.imkeren.4.2: Journeyman Beekeeper! Here, a beekeeper's hat for your home. Bzzzz.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.0.0: Granny Trudy had a recipe book. 'Back when the blobs were still pink', it says. The pages have blown away.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.0.2: All over the Chonkdom! Start with her Blob Pudding. I still know that recipe by heart.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.1.0: I found a page in a fishing net! There's a fish stew on it, with a sauce stain.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.1.1: Does it taste like the olden days?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.1.2: It tastes like Sunday. Keep cooking and we'll find more.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.2.0: This page was frozen in the Splinter Peaks: Candy Soup. Granny wrote next to it: 'for cold paws'.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.2.1: I'll make a whole pot right away!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.3.0: Honey Pancake! With a little drawing of a bee. Granny couldn't draw, look at those legs.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.3.2: It doesn't matter. What matters is that it's yummy.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.4.0: The last page. 'The cookie the Emperor never got.' The rest has been rubbed out...
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.4.1: Maybe we can bake it someday?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.koken.4.2: Someday, Journeyman Cook. Someday. Here, a chef's apron for your home, so you won't forget.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.0.0: Bonk! Every vein in the Chonkdom is a little bit of chonk sleeping under the ground.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.0.2: Exactly! Here, some fluff iron to start with. Tap the sparkly bit.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.1.0: There's a Mika who sucks veins empty with a cheese gas pump. Have you seen him?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.1.2: I swear it. You can still smell it. Keep your eyes open.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.2.0: Candy silver glitters in the Splinter Gorge. And deep inside an ice cave there's a secret vein...
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.2.2: Go and look. The Exploration Book keeps track of which spots you've found.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.3.0: Amber copper! Warm as a campfire. The roots of the tree protect it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.3.2: That's the tree rumbling. It likes you.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.4.0: You're a real miner. You find glitter veins like the best of them now.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.mijnen.4.2: Haha, exactly like that! Journeyman Miner. I'll send a little mining helmet to your home.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.0.0: I'm sewing a giant quilt for Highchonk, with a patch from every zone.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.0.1: A quilt of the whole Chonkdom?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.0.2: Exactly! Start with fluff cotton. Soft, pink and a little stubborn.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.1.0: The Shroomsbury patch is done. There's a tiny little Blob King embroidered on it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.1.2: Now the Splinter Peaks. For that I need crystal flax, it glitters so nicely.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.2.0: The ice patch crackles when you pet it. Highchonk is going to love this.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.2.2: Everyone who's cold. Even the Emperor, if he ever wants to.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.3.0: Dusk silk! Look how purple it shines. The patch from The Duskroot will be the prettiest one.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.3.1: Can I help with the stitches?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.3.2: You're already doing half, sweetie. Your stitches are just as neat as mine.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.4.0: The quilt is finished! Three zones, three patches, and still room for more.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naaien.4.2: First a little present: a Blob Giant Plushie, for your home. Journeyman Sewer, that's you now.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.naar_gilde: My story is done, but yours isn't! Go to the Crafters' Guild in Highchonk, they'll tell you the rest.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.0.0: Plants are just like guhs: if you hold them gently, they stay whole.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.0.2: Exactly! Here, some blob clover and fluff cotton to start with.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.1.0: Sometimes a golden clover grows on the Blob Meadow. On glitter spots, if you're lucky.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.1.2: Take your time. Rushing squishes the leaves.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.2.0: Ice flowers never melt. They think it's always winter.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.2.2: Oh no, they love it. Just like snow guhs.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.3.0: Glowbeetle herb gives off light, because the glowbeetles sleep on it at night.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.3.2: Clever! You already know almost as much as I do.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.4.0: My garden hat has gotten too small for all your know-how. Journeyman Picker!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.plukken.4.2: Here, your very own garden hat, for your home.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.post: A keepsake is on its way home by Post: %s
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.0.0: Do you know what this is? A splinter of the Anvil of the Order. Once, the whole city forged on it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.0.2: The Gray Emperor smashed it to pieces. Find the pieces and become a real smith. Here, a bit of iron to practice with.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.1.0: Your strikes are getting steadier! I heard there's a piece of the anvil in the Drip Caves.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.1.2: Good. And remember: a made-to-measure sword is just as sweet as a made-to-measure cuddle.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.2.0: The second piece was in the Mirror Keep. It reflected my own face... the face of a happy smith.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.2.2: Just a few. Every piece makes the anvil warmer. Go on, feel it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.3.0: With amber copper from The Duskroot the anvil almost sings. Almost!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.3.2: A smith who forges with heart. That's you, I think.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.4.0: The anvil is whole! Hear that? KLIIING. That's the sound of the Order laughing again.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.smeden.4.2: Thanks to you, Journeyman. I'll send a little mining helmet to your home, as a keepsake.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.uit: You already know my whole story. Go on and enjoy your profession!
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.0.0: Fishing is waiting, and waiting is cuddling with time.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.0.1: How do I know when to click?
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.0.2: When you see 'Bite!'. Not before. The fish is just as shy as you are.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.1.0: At night, different fish bite. The moon perch, for example.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.1.2: Then the splash guppy comes up to dance.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.vissen.2.0: The mirror trout swims in the Splinter Peaks. If you look closely, your reflection waves back.
